Integer addition c = a + b in safeAdd, protected by require(c >= a).
Integer subtraction c = a - b in safeSub, protected by require(b <= a).
Integer multiplication c = a * b in safeMul, protected by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Integer division c = a / b in safeDiv, protected by require(b > 0).

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
The onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender before transferOwnership executes.
owner state variable is compared with msg.sender inside the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
acceptOwnership authorizes execution by comparing msg.sender to newOwner.
newOwner state variable is the authorization source in acceptOwnership.
msg.sender balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed into the external receiveApproval callback in approveAndCall.
balances mapping is read and written by transfer.
balanceOf returns an entry of the balances mapping.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the caller.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes into the allowed mapping before the external call.
transfer uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer uses safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom uses safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call after updating allowance state.
The external callee can re-enter approve/approveAndCall after the allowance state change.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20 transfer call on an arbitrary token address.
The external ERC20 transfer sends tokens to the owner state variable address.
Integer addition node belongs to safeAdd and is guarded by require.
Integer subtraction node belongs to safeSub and is guarded by require.
Integer multiplication node belongs to safeMul and is guarded by a division check.
Integer division node belongs to safeDiv and is guarded by require(b > 0).
